plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Fibernet XMUX4+ optical multiplexers (enterprise PEN 29003). It reports uptime, fan-side and interior temperatures, left/right power supply status, and interface traffic.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Fan-side and interior temperatures of each Fibernet XMUX4+ unit (XMUX4-PLUS muxFanTemp / muxInteriorTemp, 1.3.6.1.4.1.29003.2.44.1.1.9.1.4 / .5). The device reports them as text; the first number in the text is used as degrees Celsius, and unparsable values are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state

dimensions.name: position
dimensions.description: Power supply position: left or right

metrics.description: Status of the left and right power supplies of each Fibernet XMUX4+ unit (muxLeftPower / muxRightPower, 1.3.6.1.4.1.29003.2.44.1.1.9.1.9 / .10). powerOn(1) is normal (1); powerOff(0) and unknown(8) are abnormal (2).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
